name: Beth-Anne Lee
story: At the 2019 New Zealand Esri User Conference, Beth-Anne Lee co-presented Eagle Technology sessions on ArcGIS field apps, including QuickCapture, Survey123 and Collector. An MSD case study also records her as a Senior GIS Analyst in the Centre for Social Research and Evaluation, using spatial analysis to review service areas and target resources.
